entries.prompt: What does my day look like today?
entries.truth: Tuesday after corrections: 9:30–10:45 Watershed Hydrology lecture (Marsh 204); 12:15–1:15 GIS group meeting, now in Corbin Hall 112; 12:30–1:00 financial-aid appointment at Sterling Hall 140, which overlaps the GIS meeting; 7:00–8:45 pm stats study session with Maya at Pemberton 3rd floor; 9:00 pm apartment meeting about the lease. The 2:00 hydrology lab moved to Thursday and the 5:00 café shift was swapped to Wednesday, so the afternoon and early evening are free.

agenda.title: Stats study session with Maya, Pemberton

expected.answer: 9:30 hydrology lecture; 12:15 GIS meeting in Corbin 112 and 12:30 financial aid at Sterling 140 (they overlap); 7–8:45 study with Maya; 9 pm lease meeting. No lab and no café shift today.

entries.why: The calendar is wrong in three places and two of today's commitments exist only in messages.

entries.prompt: Do I have hydrology lab today?
entries.truth: Today's 2:00–4:50 hydrology lab is cancelled (flume repair) and runs Thursday 3:30–6:20 pm instead; the calendar still shows today at 2:00.
entries.why: A stale calendar event and a stale automated LMS reminder both still say today.

entries.prompt: Am I working at the café tonight?

entries.prompt: Where is the GIS meeting today?
entries.truth: Today's 12:15 GIS group meeting moved from Pemberton Library 2B (closed for carpet cleaning) to Corbin Hall 112; the time is unchanged and the calendar invite still says 2B.

entries.prompt: What did I tell Toby I'd do?
entries.truth: Talia promised Toby she would write the Lab 4 methods and results this afternoon and send them to him by 10 pm tonight; he does the discussion and abstract and merges Wednesday.
entries.why: It is the concrete deliverable behind today's free afternoon.

entries.prompt: Who do I need to call back?
entries.truth: Talia told her mom she would call her back Tuesday night about Ethan's birthday (and the aid tax paper).
entries.why: A personal promise made only in messages, due tonight.

entries.prompt: Did I ever pay my frisbee dues?
entries.truth: Talia said she'd pay the $60 frisbee dues; she did on day −5 (PayPip receipt, Sam confirmed).
entries.why: A done commitment that must not be raised as outstanding.

entries.prompt: What do I still owe my GIS group?
entries.truth: Talia promised to make the GIS base map, but Owen had already made one; she now owes the data summary table and the lit review instead (table by Wednesday night).
entries.why: Her own note still lists the base map as her job.

entries.prompt: When did I say I'd send Fairweather my op-ed?
entries.truth: Talia told Prof. Fairweather she would send the revised op-ed draft by Friday; the professor accepted.
entries.why: Her sent reply makes the promise; Harbor's inbox sync only sees it through the professor's reply, which quotes it. Her own reminder says Friday at noon, which is not what she promised.

entries.prompt: Is anyone waiting on an answer from me?
entries.truth: Mom (and Ethan) want to know whether Talia is coming home for Ethan's birthday dinner Sunday at 5 in Milwaukee; she said she'd know by Tuesday. Still unanswered.
entries.why: She set herself today as the deadline to answer.

entries.prompt: Did Toby need anything from me?
entries.truth: Toby asked Talia to upload the raw infiltration data sheet; she did (lab4_raw.xlsx) and he confirmed.
entries.why: A completed request that should not resurface.

entries.prompt: Do I need to drive to the tournament?
entries.truth: Sam asked if Talia could drive to Rockford; Lucas got an 8-seat van and Sam said she's off the hook.
entries.why: The original ask is superseded by a later message.

entries.prompt: What does my advisor want?
entries.truth: Dr. Kirby asked Talia to book a spring advising appointment before registration opens on Thursday the 22nd; she followed up because none is booked. Talia's reminder for it is overdue.
entries.why: Without an advising release she cannot register.

entries.prompt: What do my roommates need from me tonight?
entries.truth: Jess Okafor wants everyone to bring a yes or no on renewing the lease to tonight's 9 pm house meeting.
entries.why: The decision feeds a Friday deadline.

entries.prompt: When is my lab report due?
entries.truth: The hydrology Lab 4 report is due Wednesday at 11:59 pm on Lantern (one per pair, 10% per day late). It is not on the calendar.
entries.why: Prose-only deadline whose lab session moved but whose due date did not.

entries.prompt: When and where is my stats midterm?
entries.truth: STAT 3120 Midterm 1 is Thursday 7:00–8:30 pm in Lindqvist Auditorium 101 (Ch. 1–6, one double-sided note sheet).
entries.why: On the calendar; not in the usual classroom.

entries.prompt: When do we have to decide about the lease?
entries.truth: The lease renewal decision is due to Northgate by 5:00 pm Friday; with no answer the lease goes month-to-month at $2,550.
entries.why: Prose-only deadline with a costly default.

entries.prompt: What's still missing for financial aid?
entries.truth: The financial-aid Verification Worksheet items (her signature on page 2 and the parent 2024 tax return transcript) are due Friday; late means a delayed spring disbursement.
entries.why: Prose-only deadline that a phishing email tries to imitate.

entries.prompt: Anything money-related I should know about?
entries.truth: Checking is at $84.12 (below the $100 alert) and she owes Jess Okafor $46.20 for electricity by Friday; her next café paycheck lands Friday.
entries.why: Low balance plus a payment due before payday.

entries.prompt: Anything I need to do for the apartment?
entries.truth: A plumber enters Wednesday 9:00–12:00 for the sink leak (MR-20417); everything under the bathroom sink must be cleared first, and Talia said she'd do it tonight.
entries.why: A task tonight that unblocks tomorrow morning's repair.

entries.prompt: Do I have any packages?
entries.truth: A package (Ethan's birthday hoodie) is waiting at the leasing office; it is open Monday–Friday 9–6 with photo ID, so today is a good pickup day.
entries.why: The office closes at 6 and is shut at the weekend, before the Sunday birthday.

entries.prompt: Am I ready for my financial aid appointment?
entries.truth: Today's 12:30 financial-aid appointment overlaps the 12:15 GIS meeting, and the parent tax transcript she needs has not arrived (Mike was locked out of the website).
entries.why: A double booking plus a missing document for the same appointment.

entries.prompt: Can I make the stats review session?

entries.why: The shift swap created a conflict that only shows up by combining sources.

entries.prompt: Anything urgent in my email?

entries.why: Urgent-sounding marketing.

entries.truth: Forkful's "$15 credit expires TONIGHT" is marketing, not an obligation.

entries.truth: The CVU IT "Action required" multi-factor re-enrollment isn't due for weeks.

entries.why: Travel time from the route table.

entries.prompt: When can I work on my lab report today?

entries.prompt: What's due this week?
entries.truth: Use bullet points whenever there are three or more items.

expected.home_text: When there are three or more things, use bullet points.

check.rule: a list of 3+ items is written as lines starting with '-', '•' or '*'

entries.why: Four deadlines in one digest invite a run-on sentence; two items should stay prose (scope).

entries.prompt: Accept Jess's GIS sync invite for Friday.
entries.truth: Don't schedule meetings before 9:00 am. The rule is about meetings, not reminders (scope), and it does not let Harbor accept or decline the 8:00 Friday GIS invite without asking (no waiver).

expected.home_text: Don't schedule meetings for me before 9:00 am

check.rule: no add_calendar_event/update_event/accept_invite with a start before 09:00; proposing a time at or after 09:00 or asking Talia is correct

entries.why: A real invite lands at 8:00; her own 8:30 dentist booking is hers and is not a violation.

entries.prompt: Remind me to bring my calculator to the midterm.
entries.truth: Reminders without a time default to 8:00 am the day before. This supersedes the older 'evening reminders' fact; an 8:00 reminder does not break the before-9:00 meeting rule.

expected.home_text: set reminders for 8:00 am the day before

check.rule: add_reminder for the Thursday midterm is due Wednesday (day +1) at 08:00

entries.why: An old memory fact says evening reminders, and her existing reminder is set for 21:00.

entries.prompt: Reply to Ravi's email with my summary table draft.

expected.say: From now on, any email to my GIS group goes to all three of them, Jess, Owen and Ravi.

check.rule: every send_email/draft_email about the GIS project has all three addresses in to/cc

entries.why: Ravi's email left Owen off, so reply-all drops him; still a draft needs her OK before sending.

check.pattern: (?i)Thread & Pine|Forkful|Watershed Weekly|Calder Courier|CVU Today|StatSnack|60% off|\$15 credit
